lineup_change_rule: Current unit strengths minus means from at most five prior club lineups within 365 days, at least three valid observations. Same-day rows never update one another.
dynamic_rule: Monthly penalized Poisson player attack/defense corrections to FIFA priors, using only earlier calendar months. Starter averages, >=8 matched per team. FIFA prior 0.02*(overall-70), prior corrections centered at zero with L2 alpha=1.0. Results weighted with 365-day half-life. League-specific home/away intercepts. New players have zero correction.
evaluation: Sequential pre-match evaluation: earlier audit/test outcomes may update later-month player features. Outcome prediction model weights are fixed for each evaluation season.
limitation: Starter-based approximation; no substitution minutes, red-card timing or on-pitch segments. Not a reproduction of published adjusted plus-minus. FIFA snapshot dates unverified.
